description: V0.12 curated function names (manual disasm reading). Applied BEFORE heuristic (V0.10) to override sub_XX names with business semantic.

names.name: state_setter_a
names.disasm: ldr r1, [pc, #4]; str r0, [r1]; bx lr
names.note: Writes arg r0 to global state slot A. 48 callers.

names.name: state_setter_b
names.disasm: ldr r1, [pc, #4]; str r0, [r1]; bx lr
names.note: Same pattern as state_setter_a but writes to different global slot B. 11 callers.

names.name: state_getter_b
names.disasm: ldr r0, [pc, #4]; ldr r0, [r0]; bx lr
names.note: Read global slot B (paired with state_setter_b at 0x0201cca8). 8 callers.

names.name: is_no_key_pressed
names.disasm: ldrh r0, [KEYINPUT]; and r0, r0, #0x8000; asr r0, r0, #0xf; bx lr
names.note: Reads NDS KEYINPUT register bit 15 (no-key-pressed indicator). Returns 1 if no key pressed, else 0.

names.name: array_field_0x54_get_idx
names.disasm: ldr r2, base; mov r1, #0x58; ldr r2, [r2]; mla r1, r0, r1, r2; ldr r0, [r1, #0x54]; bx lr

names.name: global_byte_load
names.disasm: ldr r0, [pc, #4]; ldrb r0, [r0]; bx lr
names.note: Loads uint8 from a global byte. 25 callers.

names.name: global_dword_load_chain
names.disasm: ldr r0, [pc, #4]; ldr r0, [r0]; bx lr
names.note: Loads dword from global via 2-level pointer chase. 18 callers.

names.name: state_word_eq2_check
names.note: Reads global 16-bit word and compares ==2. 20 callers.

names.name: slot_array_set_8b
names.disasm: ldr r3, base1; mov ip, #1; ldr r2, base2; str ip, [r3, r0, lsl #3]; str r1, [r2, r0, lsl #3]; bx lr
names.note: Sets array[idx] entries with enabled=1 and value=r1 at stride 8. 22 callers.

names.name: mem_fill_32b_chunked
names.disasm: push r4..r8,sb; add sb, r1, r2; lsr ip, r2, #5; stmlt r1!, {r0..r8} (32-byte fill); ...
names.note: Fills memory with 32-byte chunks at a time. 16 callers.

names.name: struct_pop_field_writer
names.note: Pops struct fields from stack and writes to struct at various offsets. 14 callers.

names.name: array_setter_4b_chain
names.disasm: stmdb sp!, {lr}; sub sp, sp, #4; mov r3, #0; ...
